metadata.description: BrineSearch pad and disposal directory with public numbered field directions that retain saved mileage; original wording remains stored for editor verification.
metadata.copy_status: 801 cleaned pad records preserved from the working dataset.  Live-only fields such as updater/date and some addresses may not be present in the cleaned export.
metadata.disposal_copy_status: All 42 Ohio disposal names were individually reviewed. 35 contain public location or well details; 7 remain name-only because no reliable exact public match was found.
metadata.audit_status: Incomplete — full live-site parity cannot be guaranteed from public indexing alone.
metadata.master_workbook_merge_note: Only workbook records not already present in the app were added. Exact matches, likely aliases, duplicate normalized keys and placeholder rows were excluded.
metadata.road_sequence_method: Rebuilt from each record's written directions. Distances, turn prose, codes, landmarks, duplicates and unsupported fragments were removed. No road was invented when the source lacked usable road information.
metadata.road_sequence_final_cleanup_note: Standardized township and county routes, corrected source-supported OCR shorthand, removed towns/landmarks and incomplete route fragments, and deduplicated alternatives.
metadata.disposal_research_method: Each Ohio disposal name was searched individually. Direct source directory directions were used when publicly accessible. Other fields were cross-checked against operator pages, regulator-derived well records, government technical documents and current facility listings. No written field directions were created from an address.
